# document-version
Version 1.2 is the controlled TAP recipe used by this benchmark.

# scope
This recipe is scoped to the validated Chlamydomonas culture workflow and must not be generalized to every microalga.

# phosphate-buffer
The phosphate buffer is prepared from K2HPO4 and KH2PO4 according to the controlled recipe table.

# K2HPO4
K2HPO4 is listed at 10.8 g per litre in the benchmark TAP stock recipe.

# NH4Cl
NH4Cl is present as the nitrogen source in this TAP recipe.

# nitrogen-source
The nitrogen source listed by this TAP recipe is NH4Cl.

# MgSO4
MgSO4 is listed at 4.0 g per litre; a 500 mL preparation uses one half of the per-litre amount.

# trace-elements
The trace-element stock is a required listed component. The document does not authorize omitting it.

# target-pH
The target pH recorded for this recipe version is 7.0.

# sterilization
Sterilization must follow the paired controlled SOP; this recipe does not independently authorize a cycle.
